original_behavior: Elapsed run duration was used as agent-side human labour.
resolution: Separated cycle time from active human effort and withheld labour value without explicit effort.

original_behavior: Available cost and token values were presented as totals under incomplete coverage.
resolution: Withheld totals and exposed partial observed sums with n/N denominators.

original_behavior: Failed runs were excluded from portfolio cost subtraction.
resolution: Assigned failed runs zero benefit while subtracting all included observed costs.

original_behavior: Claim strength was derived directly from a design-name lookup.
resolution: Introduced design ceiling, evidence status, attained strength, and withholding reasons; capped synthetic evidence.

original_behavior: Equal-timestamp events after a terminal could be accepted.
resolution: Preserved source sequence and required the terminal to be last.

original_behavior: Packages recorded hashes but had no public recomputation command.
Langfuse body descriptors retained raw SHA-256 values.
resolution: Changed the default to omit plaintext and raw value hashes; HMAC is explicit and keyed externally.

original_behavior: Absolute source paths appeared in derived artefacts.
resolution: Replaced filesystem paths with logical source identifiers.

original_behavior: Sequential writes could leave partial success artefacts after a late failure.
resolution: Published successful result directories transactionally and retained diagnostics only on failure.

original_behavior: Enterprise source-to-canonical mapping work was treated as adapter setup rather than part of the evaluated artefact boundary.
resolution: Added a vendor-neutral onboarding layer with source profiling, mapping semantics, approvals, issues, versions, and multidimensional friction reporting.

original_behavior: A single completeness gate discarded safely interpretable partial evidence.
resolution: Introduced blocked, mapping-only, partial, and complete evidence tiers while preserving bundle-wide safety and integrity blockers.

original_behavior: Run-local anomalies could terminate an otherwise trustworthy source population.
resolution: Quarantined safely isolatable runs and assigned availability, coverage, and eligibility independently for each metric family.
